jobs.description_text: TEACHER Ad Astra is a private school and learner-driven community with the mission to encourage each person who enters its doors to find a calling and change the world. Our school consists of four studios: Spark (Grades K-2), Discovery (Grades 3-5), Adventure (Grades 6-8), and Launch Pad (Grades 9-12). This is not a traditional school model. In all areas of school life, our learners are empowered to be in the driver’s seat of their learning. We combine elements of the Montessori method with Socratic guiding, hands-on experiential missions, rigorous curricula, and adaptive technology. jobs.title: E-Space 2027 Summer Internship, Arlington TX
jobs.description_text: As a company, E-Space does not believe in sticking to the path that has already been trodden. We are encountering new problems every day that need new ways of thinking. At E-Space, we use a first principles approach to solving tough technical challenges, and we look at problems differently. Most aerospace internships hand you one project, one team, and a report-out slide at the end of summer. E-Space is different: we’re a vertically integrated space company building spacecraft manufacturing capability from the ground up in Arlington, TX, and we’re writing the playbook, rather than following someone else’s. That means our interns aren’t boxed into a single lane. Our previous interns have worked across multiple disciplines in a single cohort, pitched and built their own passion projects, and watched ideas they proposed become hardware that flies, not something that gets shelved after a final presentation. If you want the mission and scale of a rapidly scaling aerospace and defense company without layers of process that come with it, this is where you should build it yourself!

This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.title: Senior Patent Agent
jobs.description_text: About the Role E-Space designs and manufactures low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites for 5G communications, associated ground-based Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and radar systems for space-based and ground-based applications. We are seeking a Senior Patent Agent to take substantial ownership of patent preparation and prosecution across these technologies. Working directly with Lead IP Counsel and engineering teams, you will turn complex inventions into high-quality patent applications and pursue commercially meaningful claim coverage. This is a hands-on role: approximately 60% of your time will involve drafting applications, with approximately 30–40% devoted to prosecution. You will personally draft most assigned applications and all U.S. Office Action responses for assigned matters, and review outside counsel’s non-U.S. Office Action responses. The role calls for an experienced practitioner who can produce high-quality work with limited supervision and is proficient using AI-based tools effectively.

jobs.description_text: E-Space is seeking a Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer to develop transmit and receive electronics for satellite communication user terminals. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can translate system and link requirements into robust RF hardware and take designs from architecture through device-level circuit design, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, validation, and production release. The successful candidate will work closely with antenna, modem, baseband, firmware, power, mechanical, thermal, test, and manufacturing teams to deliver efficient and reliable user-terminal RF hardware. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Occasional travel may be required. This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX facility. The target base pay for this position is $160,000 - $195,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

This is not a role that inherits a scheduling function. You will define it. You will set the scheduling standard, build the toolchain and templates, establish the status and baseline control process, support Program Managers and technical leads to work within it, and then own the Integrated Master Schedule for the portfolio on an ongoing basis. We are looking for a career space program scheduler — someone who has built and defended an IMS on satellite, payload, or ground systems development programs. You will have direct authority over scheduling methodology across Government Programs.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Dynamics Analyst, Deployable Antenna Structures
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Test Engineer to own electrical verification and electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) for E-Space’s integrated antenna assembly. You will build and troubleshoot electrical test setups, solder test hardware, write test software (Labview, Python), configure and run data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and operate spacecraft and instrument surrogates for verification testing. This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.description_text: The SIM Management 5G Core Engineer will analyze, design, implement, and verify the configuration and integration of subscriber data management nodes(UDR / UDM), networks, and systems across our 5G infrastructure. Your scope of work includes introduction, upgrade, expansion, functionality, and capacity scenarios on modern cloud-native UDM and UDR deployments. You will be a key contributor to the convergence of subscriber databases as platform evolves — and your work will directly shape the reliability and scalability of the networks our partners depend on.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. This role is responsible for goods receipt, unpacking, and internal parcel delivery, along with inventory storage, light kitting support, and entering/pushing through purchase requisitions for small, low-complexity orders. The role works under supervision and follows established procedures for receiving, storage, and procurement transactions.

jobs.description_text: Vice President of Engineering – Wireless Location: San Jose, CA (Hybrid) Department: Engineering About the Role Extreme Networks is seeking a Vice President of Engineering – Wireless to lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of our wireless networking portfolio, spanning wireless access points, controllers, and cloud-managed wireless software with a focus on Agentic AI capabilities across the portfolio. jobs.description_text: That mission shapes how we work. Additionally, you can voice your ideas and collaborate across departments to learn new aspects of the company. The role serves as a key partner and primary point of contact to customers; with ownership and accountability for ensuring our solutions deliver value to the customer on or ahead of schedule. jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern, AI Molecular Design
jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

jobs.title: Vice President of Business & Corporate Development
jobs.description_text: We seek a senior, highly strategic VP of Business & Corporate Development to define and lead GenBio AI's business development and strategic partnership efforts. This is a high-ownership role for a leader who is technically credible, commercially seasoned, and comfortable setting direction rather than waiting for it. You will help shape GenBio AI's business model, build the relationships that turn our technology into durable scientific and commercial partnerships, and make the case to the market for what AIDO Cell makes possible. You will work alongside the founders and executive team with the seniority and confidence to guide them, intellectually and operationally, and to take external work off their plates. You will see where GenBio AI's technology can create value, identify the gap between what it can do and what the market understands today, and close that gap through new connections, partnership structures, and proposed experiments. The role requires strategic judgment, a strong scientific foundation, and the credibility to engage directly with senior leaders across the pharmaceutical and technology industries. Above range includes only base compensation. The full package will include an annual performance based target bonus and substantial early stage equity in addition to the base salary.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate (Lenexa, KS)
jobs.description_text: At Fullscript, our warehouse team helps practitioners and patients get what they need, with care and intention. We work together, support one another, and take pride in being part of something that helps people. We are hiring Warehouse Associates at our Lenexa, Kansas warehouse. In this role, you will scan, pick, and pack orders and work alongside a team that enjoys working together. The work connects to real people, the team is welcoming, and the environment is positive. If you want a full-time warehouse role where the work feels meaningful and the people make the day better, this could be a great fit. **A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status.

jobs.title: 1st Vice President, Compliance (OFS)
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The 1st Vice President, Compliance for CIM is responsible for supporting the CCO of CIM and a CIM affiliate, OFS Management (“OFS”), in ensuring that OFS maintains a compliance program reasonably designed to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations. The 1st VP, Compliance is responsible for the day-to-day management of the OFS compliance program, including oversight of a team of two compliance professionals. The 1st VP, Compliance assists the CCO of OFS-managed registered investment companies in maintaining their compliance programs, including their 38a-1 manuals and reports to the relevant boards, with the expectation that the 1st VP, Compliance assumes the role of CCO of at least one of the investment companies. The 1st VP, Compliance is also committed to the highest ethical standards and constant reinforcement of CIM’s and OFS’ uncompromising culture of compliance.

jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Loan Servicing Analyst will provide key support to the Loan Servicing team, which oversees a portfolio of complex commercial bridge and construction loans. This role is essential to maintaining strong relationships with customers, borrowers, banks, and internal stakeholders. The position’s primary focus is executing analytical tasks, ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of loan management processes, and enhancing the quality and timeliness of service delivery.

jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Assistant Property Manager supports effective administration of policies and procedures that promote well-managed, well-maintained buildings and grounds at company-owned commercial office properties to achieve maximum return on investment-grade, commercial real estate assets. The APM should be capable of managing the building staff/community in the absence of the Property Manager. The APM is responsible for assisting the Property Manager with the management of all on-site operations and achieving property financial and operational objectives.

jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: Reporting to the Vice President, Compliance, the AVP supports and helps execute the compliance program for CIM's registered and non-registered investment advisers. This role is responsible for leading key compliance processes, coordinating cross-functional compliance initiatives, and providing practical guidance on regulatory and operational matters. The AVP partners with stakeholders across the organization to identify compliance risks, strengthen controls, and enhance the effectiveness of the firm's compliance program while ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer – Command & Control
jobs.description_text: About The Role: We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Command & Control team in Atlanta. The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, and delivery of software supporting Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Pilot Vehicle Interfaces (PVI), Command & Control (C2), telemetry, and vehicle communications. This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers. This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Clinical Outreach Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Clinical Outreach Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical bridge for high-risk patients, utilizing your clinical expertise to navigate the critical window between hospital discharge and home recovery. In this high-impact, telephonic role, you will perform complex medication reconciliations, identify looming clinical red flags, and proactively close care gaps to prevent unnecessary ER visits and readmissions. By blending empathetic patient education with data-driven population health tools, you will empower patients to manage their health effectively while collaborating directly with primary care practices to ensure no one falls through the cracks of the healthcare system. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones.

jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (remote)
jobs.description_text: The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

jobs.description_text: As a Pharmacy Outreach Specialist, you'll be a vital link between patients, providers, and pharmacies, helping people stay on track with the medications that keep them healthy. In this role, you'll combine empathy, problem-solving, and clear communication to break down the real-world barriers that keep patients from taking their medications as prescribed, from cost concerns to simple forgetfulness. Your work directly improves patient health outcomes and contributes to pharmacy quality measures that matter across the healthcare system, all while building valuable skills in patient engagement, pharmacy operations, and healthcare communication.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) for our Florida practices and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Please note: candidates must be based in Florida to be considered. Note on Travel: This is primarily a remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice. Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others. Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 base + bonuses + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.description_text: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

Leveraging solid expertise in Salesforce development, integration patterns, data modeling, and system design, you will align platform capabilities with business objectives, optimize systems for performance and security, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and senior engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (Remote)
jobs.description_text: Aledade is seeking a Senior Counsel to join our Privacy Team, reporting to our Privacy Officer and Associate General Counsel. The ideal candidate will work independently to advise on privacy risk, own key privacy verticals end-to-end, and serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders on evolving privacy and AI regulatory issues. The successful candidate must bring strong legal judgment, confidence using AI tools to work efficiently, and enthusiasm for advising the business on emerging AI laws and governance frameworks. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer II - IAM
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Security Engineer II at Aledade, we play a central role in helping secure our enterprise, cloud native environments, and applications. We’re looking for security engineers that understand data and automation are important ingredients to our mission and know how to actively employ these ingredients at scale. Beyond the technical expertise, we value individuals who can partner cross-functionally across various teams, driving impactful outcomes and further securing our digital landscape. We prioritize Security-as-Code and API-first automation over manual administration, building resilient identity pipelines that scale seamlessly with our growth.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Data & Algorithm Engineering
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer I at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our data models and Databricks pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. The Patient Domain Team is responsible for turning complex health care data into well-defined insights about our patients that describes who they are and how they interact with the health care system. We are responsible for telling our partner practices more about who their patients are and how to ensure they receive the care they need. We are also responsible for figuring out how to monitor and observe our models in action to ensure they are driving impact across the company.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Risk
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer II at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our web application and data pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. They embrace strategies that minimize risk, leaning towards observability, alerting, metrics, high test coverage, and frequent releases that incrementally build value.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- AI Platform
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Software Engineer on Aledade's AI Core Platform team, you will help build and operate the shared infrastructure that enables applications and AI agents across Aledade to securely and reliably access foundation models. You will work on the platform capabilities behind model access, including model gateways, cloud AI services, provider integrations, routing and fallback, usage controls, observability, reliability, and model governance. We’re looking for engineers who think beyond implementing individual features and consider the full lifecycle of production platform systems: architecture, scalability, failure modes, security, observability, operational readiness, cost, and developer experience. You will help evolve the platform as AI adoption grows across Aledade, building reusable and self-service capabilities rather than one-off solutions. You will work closely with engineers, product partners, security, infrastructure teams, and teams building AI applications and agents. Successful engineers in this role are comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic technical decisions, and building secure, maintainable, observable, and resilient systems.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients. The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale. In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

If you're proactive, people-driven, and energized by fast-moving environments, we'd love to meet you. This role will be based out of our Boston headquarters with a hybrid schedule, requiring 2 to 3 days in the office per week.

jobs.title: Head of Business Development, Defense Primes
jobs.description_text: Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet. Machina Labs is changing that. jobs.description_text: About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead the team that builds the software brain of our robotic factory. This role reports to the VP of Software & IT. This team owns the full journey from 3D geometry to robotic instructions, and its work is used every day by internal customers to operate our production systems. The team's portfolio spans: Factory web applications - the suite of web applications that take a part from 3D geometry all the way to executable robotic instructions, used by internal customers to operate the factory. This role may be filled in multiple locations, and compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s work location in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Robotics Hardware
jobs.description_text: Job Description: Machina Labs is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own mechanical hardware design for our robotic sheet forming cells, taking designs from concept through release and into production. You will own the design of machine subsystems, make and defend the design decisions that set how that hardware performs, lasts, and is serviced, and work closely with Robotics, Forming Process, Electrical, Controls, and Production to get it built and running reliably. As the machine and the company grow, the areas you own will grow and shift with them. The ideal candidate has owned a complex mechanical subsystem on industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment, and is comfortable taking it from first concept to hardware running in production.

jobs.description_text: Our teams of highly skilled engineers and designers use cutting-edge software and technology, to enhance the driving experience and reduce environmental impact. ​​This role oversees IP protection, prosecution, and strategic activity for all Mercedes-Benz IP operations in North America. About MBRDNA. Embedded in a worldwide network, Mercedes-Benz Research & Development North America (MBRDNA) continuously strives to remain at the forefront of successful automotive research and development. MBRDNA includes locations in Silicon Valley, Atlanta, Ann Arbor, and Carlsbad. In Silicon Valley, we work on key areas of Advanced Interaction Design, Digital User Experience, AI/Machine Learning integration and infrastructure for vehicle personalization, Autonomous Driving, Customer Research and Business Innovation. In Ann Arbor, the focus is on Powertrain including battery development/design, charging, eDrive Testing and Regulatory Affairs Division. The Advanced Vehicle Design in Carlsbad, California completes the picture. Together, all the developers, technicians, engineers and designers take on the challenges of creating the next mobility innovation for Mercedes-Benz customers around the world. They are inspired by the newest trends, find the best solutions for the customer, develop the latest and greatest technologies and create the next generation of connected, safe, sustainable and luxurious vehicles.​ This is an on-site position based in San Jose, CA, Atlanta, Georgia or Ann Arbor, MI

The role identifies, evaluates and executes investment and collaboration opportunities across digitization, electrification and other priority technology areas. Working with limited supervision, this position manages defined projects and processes, coordinates cross-functional diligence and proof-of-concept activities, and influences internal and external stakeholders on operational approaches, practices and decisions. The role applies advanced investment, partnership and market knowledge to resolve difficult and sometimes complex issues and deliver outcomes with significant impact on departmental results. Relocation assistance (domestic or international) is not provided for this position.​

jobs.title: Sr. Development Engineer, Connectivity Systems
jobs.description_text: Our teams of highly skilled engineers and designers use cutting-edge software and technology, to enhance the driving experience and reduce environmental impact. ​The US Vehicle Integration organization at Mercedes-Benz plays a critical role in delivering software-defined vehicles that meet U.S. customer expectations and are commensurate with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Within this organization, the Infotainment Development Testing team is on forefront and are directly working with global developers to validate the newest software releases and prototype products. Beyond traditional testing, our team serves as the voice of the North American customer throughout the vehicle development process. This means we are working closely with global engineering teams, translate customer needs into technical development specifications, and validate that the final product meets and exceeds our requirements and quality standards. We are seeking engineers who take ownership, think critically, and are passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences. Successful candidates can independently manage and deliver complex projects, make data-driven decisions, and collaborate effectively across global teams. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving technical investigations, and turning complex findings into actionable improvements. jobs.title: Sr. System Integration Engineer
jobs.description_text: Our teams of highly skilled engineers and designers use cutting-edge software and technology, to enhance the driving experience and reduce environmental impact. ​​The MBRDNA Autonomous Driving Team is looking for motivated and passionate engineers who will help to integrate our ADAS software package into Mercedes-Benz vehicles. Our Team is working with global teams and partners to create SW Packages that can be rolled out to a large fleet of development vehicles all over the world. This Team is responsible for providing development and pre-production vehicles. Furthermore, we are supporting the pre-production vehicle phase until the products reach the end-customer. Your role is to develop, verify and document software packages to use them for V&V activities. This involves flashing ECUs, verifying vehicle readiness, and performing test drives. The role requires troubleshooting and debugging issues on software and signal level. We expect you to coordinate with the global team on a day-to-day basis and drive topics individually. You will get the chance to experience the next generation Mercedes-Benz ADAS Systems along its way to the customer.​ Relocation assistance (domestic or international) is not provided for this position.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, our vision is to bring communities together by solving our neighbors’ biggest challenges. We’re building the largest hyperlocal marketplace the world has seen. We’ve raised over $75 million from top-tier investors such as Andreessen Horowitz and the creators of DoorDash, Airbnb, and Uber. We are looking for phenomenal individuals to help solve our Neighbors’ biggest challenges. As a Customer Success Specialist, you will engage directly with our renters, hosts, and internal team members in the pursuit of creating an exceptional customer experience. As a primary point of contact, you will field inbound calls, emails, and chats, as well as proactively communicate with our customers to ensure success. Ideal candidates will be confident and comfortable with verbal and written communication.

jobs.title: Data Science Internship (Current PhD) - Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: We're excited to add a Data Scientist Intern to our Data & Analytics team. You'll work on the machine learning models we already run in production, including lifetime value, unit economics, and forecasting, making them more accurate and showing with evidence that they've improved. You'll also help Product, Marketing, and Sales divisions design A/B tests and interpret the results. Your work feeds directly into decisions across a marketplace that operates in nearly every U.S. city. This is a great fit for a PhD student who wants to apply their research skills to live business problems. You'll report to our Data & Analytics manager, with regular code review and hands-on mentorship. Our stack: Python, dbt, and Dagster on Redshift and Athena, with a Cube semantic layer and Superset for BI.

jobs.title: FP&A Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About the Role As our FP&A Intern, you’ll work on the numbers leadership uses to run the company. You’ll help build the annual plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range models, and you’ll present your work to our senior leadership team. You’ll report to the FP&A Manager and work on the real plan, the real forecasts, and the materials that go in front of our board. Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace, which makes the finance work here unusually interesting. You’ll dig into how supply and demand grow market by market, what drives our take rate, and what it costs to acquire a host or a renter. By the end of the summer, you’ll own expense forecasting for the entire business. This internship is a direct path to a full-time role. Strong performers leave with a full-time offer to join the team after graduation.

jobs.title: Head of Performance Marketing
jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, we're building the largest hyperlocal storage and parking marketplace in the world. We've raised over $75 million from top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace operates in all 50 states, and we're just getting started.

jobs.title: Marketplace Growth Associate
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Marketplace Growth Associate, you’ll work with Neighbor’s hosts: the commercial and residential property owners who list their storage and parking space on our marketplace. Hosts are the supply side of everything we do. The more easily renters can find a host’s space, the more that host earns and the faster the marketplace grows in every city we serve. You’ll be one of the people making that happen, one host at a time. Most of your day (50–75%) is outbound phone calls with hosts. On each call, you’ll help a host make their listing stronger and easier to find: setting up a Google Maps pin, tightening photos and descriptions, getting the price right, and building up reviews. The goal is to turn their space into steady, growing income. The rest of your time is operations: running the signage program, tracking results and finding ways to make the whole thing work better. This role fits you if you like being on the phone, you can manage a high volume of work on your own, and you tend to notice when a process could run better.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, our vision is to bring communities together by solving our neighbors’ biggest challenges. We’re building the largest hyperlocal marketplace the world has seen. We’ve raised over $75 million from top-tier investors such as Andreessen Horowitz and the creators of DoorDash, Airbnb, and Uber. As a Sales Development Representative, you will be instrumental in driving our expansion strategy. This role is a direct feeder into the Account Executive (AE) path, offering significant advancement opportunities for high-performers. Your primary focus will be on prospecting and qualifying outbound leads from small to mid-market companies, scheduling product demonstrations, and assisting with the initial client onboarding process. This role is critical to the business and you will have the opportunity to work cross-functionally to achieve an excellent customer experience while having a direct impact on our revenue and growth.

jobs.title: UX Designer (Mid and Senior Level Opportunities)
jobs.description_text: About the Role Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace for self storage and vehicle storage. Hosts list everything from garages and driveways to RV pads and commercial facility units, and renters compare options, book, and manage reservations through Neighbor’s website and apps. You’ll report directly to a Co-Founder and our VP of Product & Design, and you’ll set the bar for design craft across the company. That means mentoring Neighbor’s other designers, shaping product direction with PMs and engineers from the first sketch, and making sure real renter insight reaches every team. Renters on Neighbor compare everything from storage facility units to neighborhood garages and RV pads. Helping them choose with confidence is a hard design problem, and solving it moves the business directly. This role is based in our Lehi, Utah office, in person Tuesday through Friday, with the option to work from home on Mondays.

jobs.title: Sr Director, DSP Partnerships & Growth
jobs.description_text: OpenX is seeking a strategic, commercially driven Senior Director, DSP Partnerships & Growth (Americas) to lead the regional DSP partnerships organization and accelerate revenue growth across established and emerging buying platforms. As the programmatic ecosystem evolves, OpenX is redefining how supply-side and demand-side platforms collaborate to drive performance, efficiency, and innovation. This leader will play a critical role in strengthening our position with leading DSPs, expanding demand diversification, and translating emerging market opportunities into sustainable commercial growth. This is more than a traditional partnership management role. We're looking for a commercial builder and strategic operator who can independently lead a high-performing team, establish executive-level relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and turn complex technical capabilities into differentiated business value. Reporting to the Global Head of DSP, this leader will drive the commercial growth and execution of OpenX's US DSP partnerships, translating strategic priorities into measurable revenue outcomes while collaborating closely with DSP Operations, Product, and cross-functional commercial teams.
